title: Potential Games for Self-Neighborhood Channel Mixing in Graph Neural Networks
abstract: arXiv:2611.30829v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Graph message passing must balance two competing objectives: incorporating neighborhood signals while preserving node-specific information. We model this trade-off as a game in which nodes choose how to mix their own representations with strict-neighborhood aggregates. For fixed channel representations, task supervision defines a common-payoff game, while local distinctness payoffs induce an exact potential game whose potential is the degree-normalized strict Dirichlet energy. We introduce CG2, which amortizes these choices through a shared six-parameter policy per layer based on local channel statistics and can be trained using either objective. Controlled comparisons show that the shared task-trained policy improves mean performance over fixed mixing on three of five heterophily benchmarks, with significant gains on two, while free per-node actions trained with either objective rarely improve on the same baseline. On the ECHO long-rang

translated_title: 图神经网络中自-邻域通道混合的势博弈方法
translated_abstract: 图消息传递必须平衡两个相互竞争的目标：既融合邻域信号，又保留节点自身特有的信息。我们将这种权衡建模为一个博弈，其中节点自行决定如何将自身表示与严格邻域（排除自身）的聚合结果进行混合。对于固定的通道表示，任务监督定义了一个共同收益博弈，而局部差异性收益则诱导出一个精确势博弈，其势函数为度归一化的严格狄利克雷能量。我们提出了 CG2，它通过每层一个基于局部通道统计量的共享六参数策略来摊销这些混合选择，并且可以使用任一目标进行训练。受控对比实验表明，共享的任务训练策略在五个异配性基准中的三个上取得了优于固定混合的平均性能，其中两个基准上有显著提升；而使用任一目标训练的自由逐节点动作则很少能在同一基线上有所改进。在 ECHO 长程（原文截断）……
tldr: 该论文将图神经网络中“融合邻域信号”与“保留节点自身信息”的权衡建模为势博弈（其势函数为度归一化的严格狄利克雷能量），并提出 CG2 方法，通过每层共享的六参数策略进行自-邻域通道混合，在异配性基准上优于固定混合和逐节点自由混合方案。
en_tdlr: This paper models the self-neighborhood channel mixing trade-off in graph neural networks as an exact potential game and introduces CG2, a shared six-parameter per-layer policy that outperforms both fixed and free per-node mixing on heterophily benchmarks.
